# Hundred thousand physical books and million digital books available for researchers and students

  * 12/06/2020
  * 1996 Views
  * The library of the Imam Hussain Shrine is deemed one of Iraq’s most significant libraries, for it has a great variety of up-to-date scientific books.

In an interview with Hussain Adnan, the director of the Information Systems Division in the Department of Intellectual and Cultural Affairs, he said, “The library of the Imam Hussain Shrine has more than 120,000 books in various subjects.”

Adnan added that the library always receives visitors and researchers from a lot of countries, such as Saudi Arabia, Yemen, Kuwait, Iran, and other Arabic and foreign countries.

He mentioned that there are more than 70,000 books in various languages, noting that 60% of them are academic and scientific books.

“The digital library has more than 26 million books in various subjects, such as Engineering, Medicine, Physics, Chemistry, and Agriculture — and any researcher or student can obtain copies of any of those books on the website of the library, exclusively,” Adnan said further.

By: Qais Mohammed EnNejjar

Editing: Faris EshShereafy

## المكتبة المركزية في الجامعة المستنصرية ترفد مكتبة مسجد الكوفة بالكتب والرسائل والورقة والإلكترونية

 تاريخ النشر : 27 آب 2017  عدد الزيارات: 978  طباعة الخبر

أهدت المكتبة المركزية في الجامعة المستنصرية مجموعة من الكتب والأطاريح والرسائل الورقية والإلكترونية إلى مكتبة مسجد الكوفة المعظم.

وأعرب أمين مسجد الكوفة المعظم والمزارات الملحقة به السيد محمد مجيد الموسوي عن شكره لأمينة المكتبة د. زينب عبد الواحد الوائلي خلال لقائه مؤكداً أن الهدف من التعاون الثقافي بين المسجد والجامعة هو الارتقاء بالمستوى العلمي للمجتمع وتسهيل حصول طلبة العلم والبحوث العلمية على المصادر في المكتبات .

وفي السياق ذاته أهدى بيت الحكمة الثقافي مجموعة من الكتب والمجلات الصادرة عنه إلى مكتبة مسجد الكوفة المعظم، تثميناً للجهود التي تبذلها الأمانة في خدمة العلم والعلماء.

جدير بالذكر ان المكتبة العامة في مسجد الكوفة المعظم تأسست في عام 2006 وتحتوي على أكثر من عشرين ألف كتاب ورقي واكثر من ثلاثين ألف كتاب الكرتوني إضافة إلى الآلاف من الاطاريح والرسائل الإلكترونية ويرتادها العديد من الطلبة والباحثين يومياً.انتهى

The Central Library (CL) at Salahaddin University–Erbil is one of the University's principal academic and scientific support units, providing, organizing, preserving and facilitating access to print and digital information resources for students, faculty, researchers and the wider academic community.

Established alongside the University itself, the Library saw major growth in 1980–1981 (over 120,000 volumes, 844 periodical titles) and relocated to Erbil that same year with the rest of the University.

# Policy

The policy of the Central Library for the University’s library collections, study spaces and electronic information resources.

The Library's Policies and Guidelines establish an institutional framework for strategic planning, governance, service delivery, collection development, research support and continuous enhancement of library operations.

#### Clear standards

Institutional expectations for the governance and delivery of library services.

#### Equitable access

Inclusive, accessible and sustainable access to resources, collections and technologies.

#### Teaching & research

Strengthening the Library's contribution to teaching, learning, research and innovation.

#### Collection management

Systematic selection, acquisition, classification, cataloguing and preservation.

#### Digital transformation

Strategic adoption of emerging technologies to enhance access and quality.

#### Information competency

Developing users' capacity to identify, evaluate and use reliable information.

#### Heritage safeguarding

Sustainable management of special, rare and valuable collections.

#### Clear roles

Defined responsibilities and coordination among the Library and stakeholders.

#### Evidence-based improvement

Systematic assessment, data-informed evaluation and stakeholder feedback.

Central Library

# Mission & Vision

The mission, vision and guiding principles of the Central Library.

## Vision

To become a leading academic and digital library in the Kurdistan Region, recognized for scholarly excellence, digital transformation, inclusive access to knowledge, and innovative information services.

## Mission

The Central Library advances teaching, learning, research, innovation and knowledge creation by providing equitable access to high-quality scholarly resources, integrated print and digital collections, technology-enabled information services, research support and information literacy programs, while preserving the University's intellectual heritage.

## Core values

#### Equity, accessibility & inclusion

Equitable, inclusive access to resources for all members of the University community.

#### User-centeredness

Users at the center of library services and decision-making.

#### Scholarly excellence & quality

High standards of academic quality, accuracy and professional excellence.

#### Information competency

Developing users' ability to identify, evaluate and responsibly use information.

#### Innovation & digital transformation

Embracing emerging technologies and innovative library practices.

#### Collaboration & partnership

Meaningful collaboration with departments, colleges, researchers and libraries.

#### Preservation & continuous improvement

Preserving the University's intellectual heritage while continuously improving services.

وجلس عليه السلام بين بابي الرواق والناس كلهم بين يديه، وكان الدار كالسوق بالأحاديث، فلما خرج عليه السلام وجلس أمسك الناس فما كنا نسمع إلاّ العطسة والسعلة، ثم خرج خادم فوقف بحذاء أبي محمد عليه السلام، وأخرجت الجنازة وخرج عليه السلام يمشي حتى خرج بها إلى الشارع، وكان أبو محمد عليه السلام صلى عليه قبل أن يخرج إلى الناس، وصلى عليه لما خرج المعتمد، ثم دفن في دار من دوره، وصاحت سر من رأى يوم موته صيحة واحدة.
